from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

with sync_playwright() as p:
    browser = p.chromium.launch(headless=True)
    for mode in ('dialog', 'inline'):
        page = browser.new_page(viewport={\"width\": 1440, \"height\": 1000})
        page.goto(f'http://127.0.0.1:4001/delete.html?mode={mode}', wait_until='networkidle')
        octopus = page.locator('[data-id=\"octopus\"]')
        octopus.locator('.menu-trigger').click()
        octopus.locator('.delete-action').click()
        if mode == 'dialog':
            assert page.locator('#delete-dialog').is_visible()
            assert 'cannot be undone' in page.locator('#delete-dialog').inner_text().lower()
            page.locator('#confirm-delete').click()
        else:
            assert 'Click again to delete forever' in octopus.locator('.delete-action').inner_text()
            octopus.locator('.delete-action').click()
        assert page.locator('#delete-all-count').inner_text() == '2'
        assert not octopus.is_visible()
        page.locator('#delete-archive-nav').click()
        assert page.get_by_text('Archive is empty').is_visible()
        page.screenshot(path=f'prototypes/delete-{mode}-confirmed.png', full_page=True)
        page.close()
    browser.close()
print('Checks passed: both confirmation methods permanently remove the bookmark without moving it to Archive.')
